concepts.title: Host-cell dependence
concepts.quote: All viruses depend on cells for reproduction and metabolic processes.

concepts.title: Replication machinery
concepts.quote: By themselves, viruses do not encode for all of the enzymes necessary for viral replication.

concepts.title: DNA-virus replication sites
concepts.quote: In eukaryotic cells, most DNA viruses can replicate inside the nucleus, with an exception observed in the large DNA viruses, such as the poxviruses, that can replicate in the cytoplasm.

concepts.title: RNA-virus replication sites
concepts.quote: RNA viruses that infect animal cells often replicate in the cytoplasm.

concepts.title: Virulent phages
concepts.quote: Virulent phages typically lead to the death of the cell through cell lysis.
